summary: The games roadmap distinguishes reusable producer/template qualification from each product’s installed and native acceptance. Templates composes the published reference; Game owns the shared WASM producer; SC2 and BAR retain product adapters, native gateways, clocks, receipts and authority, while FourD retains rules and saves. The selected presentation sequence is FourD before SC2/BAR; compatible WASM-only adoption can proceed without the FourD presentation pilot. Source delivery, image/build preparation and producer fixtures do not establish native gameplay, cleanup or product acceptance. FourD automated technical qualification also does not supply consenting-player evidence or permanent publication. Consult each owning plan for the exact accepted original and remaining boundary; this record creates no new dependency, operation grant or completion claim.
title: Shared game producers and product acceptance have different owners
